product.name: Nango Unified API Platform
product.description: A unified API platform providing access to over 400 APIs with pre-built integrations, developer tools, and UI components for product integration development.

product.name: Nango Auth
product.description: An OAuth authorization service enabling user authorization with 400+ APIs, managing access tokens and credential refresh automatically.

product.name: Nango Custom Integration Service
product.description: A service where Nango engineers build custom integrations tailored to specific customer requirements.

product.name: Nango Integration Infrastructure
product.description: Infrastructure supporting scalable, reliable integrations with features like real-time observability, durable execution, and credential management.
